02 — a birthday note

Just a little letter

Nothing grand. Just a few sincere wishes.
For Cawa · on your birthday

Dear Cawa,

Happy birthday! I hope this new chapter brings you plenty of reasons to smile, peaceful days when you need them, and little surprises that make ordinary moments feel special.

I hope you keep finding things that make you excited, people who make you feel comfortable, and opportunities that help you grow into the person you want to be. And on the days that feel a bit heavy, I hope you remember to be kind to yourself, too.

Thank you for being you. I hope today treats you gently, your favorite things find their way to you, and the year ahead holds more good memories than you can count.

Have a lovely birthday, and enjoy your day at your own pace. You deserve good things, today and always.

with warm wishes,

Made with care, just to celebrate you. No big speech — only honest wishes for a really good year ahead.

♡

May your days be soft
and your memories golden.

happy birthday, cawa · with care
